context: A retired exec mentors a current boss
purpose: Teach: 晋/炉/包装/試みる/封筒/簡素/直結/軽視

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 晋一郎、若い頃から器が大きかった。
lines.en: Shin-ichiro had a generous spirit even when he was young.
lines.style: Reflective, measured pace. Slight nostalgic lift on the name. Eyes distant, remembering. Not pontificating — simply observing aloud. Warm regard underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今、電気炉の最新化を進めてくれています。
lines.en: Yes. He's been spearheading the modernization of the electric furnace.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Steady, attentive tone — not defensive, just clear. Slight emphasis on the work itself, not the person. Direct eye contact with the elder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 包装の試みる工夫、市場で評価されているか。
lines.en: And the packaging innovations — are they finding favor in the market?
lines.style: Curious, probing gently. Not skeptical, but testing. Lean slightly forward. Pause before 'market' — the word that matters. Genuine interest in the answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。簡素ながら機能的、封筒の試作も話題です。
lines.en: Yes. They're simple but functional. The envelope prototypes have been generating real interest.
lines.style: Steady pride in the detail. Speak with modest confidence — not boasting, just stating fact. Slight lift on 'envelope prototypes' — the concrete proof.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 技術と市場、直結を忘れるな。需要を軽視すれば終わる。
lines.en: Don't lose sight of the connection between technology and the market. Overlook what people actually need, and everything falls apart.
lines.style: Firm wisdom, not harsh. Weight on 'connection' and 'need.' Slow pace, deliberate. This is hard-won knowledge. Eye contact steady. Not lecturing — warning with care.
